derivation.method: Remove provider PBR materials and textures; Import the provider OBJ geometry (Y-up to Z-up, -Z forward; material library and texture maps not loaded) and export GLB; Validate mesh; weld coincident vertices; dissolve degenerates; recalculate normals; collapse decimation only when above target with validation between passes; triangulate and validate before measuring. Remove wire edges, split edges shared by more than two faces and remove zero-area faces (counts in quality.topology_repairs). Never subdivide to inflate counts.

quality.use: Visual entourage; not certified for fabrication or structural analysis

external_reference_status: Text prompts only: no image was given to any stage.
dimension_basis: Heights are the target heights at which Project Y2K's Neon Front scene placed each prop (twofronts/world/place_assets.py: planter pod 1.1 m, vending machine 2.4 m, kiosk 2.6 m, holo sign 3.4 m, hover scooter 1.2 m, hover car 1.6 m); Meshy's OBJ units are arbitrary, so each mesh was scaled uniformly to that height and its width and depth measured after scaling. Y2K's later ginkgo_props_v061 pass used 1.9 m for the vending machine and 1.78 m for the scooter. Speculative designs; not a physical survey.
reference_review: Reviewed on 2026-11-20: text-to-3D has no input image. The library geometry was checked in its archive preview (640 px) and in untextured front, side, back and three-quarter views (rendered 900 px, viewed at 450 px) The prompt asks for no text or letters. Meshy's texture atlases for this route are fragmented per triangle and are not distributed. No logos or brand marks. The porthole panel carries a few small raised symbols with no legible letters. The back has two arched recesses above a round knob that read loosely as a face; not a likeness of any character. The prompt's cyan sphere on a stalk did not appear.
